title: Mechanical Automation
heading: Mechanical Automation
body_html: HVAC ( Heating, Ventilating and Air Conditioning) system mechanical devices such as Air Handling Units, Circulation - Heating - Cooling Pumps, Wastewater Pumps, Fire Pumps, Duct Type and Cell Type Fans, Stair Pressurization Fans, Water Tanks, Jet Fans, Water Boosters, Boilers, Heat Exchangers, Chiller Groups from a single center control, monitoring and reporting are provided within Mechanical Automation Systems.
